q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: SELECT f.bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinkers, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, mf.most_frequent_customer FROM frequents AS f JOIN serves AS s ON f.bar = s.bar JOIN (SELECT f1.bar, f1.drinker AS most_frequent_customer FROM frequents AS f1 JOIN (SELECT bar, drinker, MAX(times_a_week) AS max_times FROM frequents GROUP BY bar, drinker) AS mf_sub ON f1.bar = mf_sub.bar AND f1.drinker = mf_sub.drinker AND f1.times_a_week = mf_sub.max_times) AS mf ON f.bar = mf.bar GROUP BY f.bar, mf.most_frequent_customer ORDER BY f.bar
